text:
sam: Heads-up: scheduling a quiet deploy tomorrow 03:30 UTC for the model-serving changes. Owner: sam. Will run canary -> ramp. Please review rollback runbook and confirm rollback criteria. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-model-serve (PR: D-512)

jen: quick Q — does this require a DB migration? any downtime windows?

sam: No schema changes. Just service rollout + kv-cache warm. No downtime expected. We'll cut traffic to canary 5% for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then ramp.

leon: I'll be on-call for the window. Can monitor latency/SLOs and initiate rollback if error-rate > 2% or p99 > 800ms for >2m.

maya: Added one more rollback trigger: increase in token cost per-minute by >20% vs baseline during canary. Also make sure feature-flag toggle exists: `ff.model_v2_enable` (set to false to stop).

sam: Rollback runbook excerpt:
```bash
# rollback sequence
./deployctl rollback --service model-serve --to-tag v1.28.3
./ops/kv-invalidate --prefix model_v2_cache || true
```
Trigger conditions listed in runbook: 5xx spike, sustained p99, or regression on smoke prompts. Owner to run rollback unless exec says otherwise.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy requested by @sam for 2300001111 -> window 2300042000. CI: passed. :white_check_mark:

jen: acked. ran smoke prompts locally, default prompts look fine. :thumbsup:

leon: noted. I'll have the rollback command ready, and SSH keys staged.

sam: final call: If no objections by 03:10 UTC then GO. Please post "GO" or "HOLD". I'll kick at 03:30.

maya: GO from infra. I'll watch autoscaling and routing toggles.

jen: GO

leon: GO

sam: GO — deploying at 03:30 UTC. I'll post progress in this thread.
